messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] gpu-cluster-west-1 / pool-A queue growth detected. queue_length=18420 -> sustained >15k for 10m, p50_latency up 3x. Auto-escalation -> @oncall.

Sam Park: taking incident. I see autoscaler failing to add nodes. Symptoms: queue grows, tokens/timeouts, lots of prefix-cache misses in runtime logs.

Sam Park: immediate ask: can someone confirm autoscaler errors? `kubectl -n infra logs autoscaler-0` output looked like `failed to allocate: reserved_quota_reached`.

Priya Nair: Confirming — autoscaler shows repeated API 429s from cloud provider when trying to allocate GPUs. Also found rollout 2245 earlier today changed batching config (devex/2245). Suspect batching change increased memory/backpressure.

Carlos Mendes: Data point from serving runtime: prefix_cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 18% after that deploy. Continuous batching window jumped from 150ms -> 800ms in the new config. That increases in-flight KV cache pressure and causes more eviction + cache misses.

Mei Li: Logs: runtime stderr snippet:
```
[2026-03-15 02:14:23] kv_cache eviction: shard=12 evicted=7400 ttl=45s
[2026-03-15 02:14:23] batch_builder: open_batches=1200, avg_doc_len=600, batch_window=800ms
[2026-03-15 02:14:24] throughput_drop: tokens/s  -> 37% of baseline
```

Sam Park: Paging note: customer-facing impact = increased tail latency and 5xx spikes for generation endpoints. On hosted tier 2 customers report timeouts.

Priya Nair: Quick numbers: affected requests ~ 9.2% of total RPS for west region. Error rate for generation endpoints increased from 0.3% -> 3.8% in the last 20m. Premium customers impacted (list redacted).

Carlos Mendes: Autoscaler status (admin API):
```
GET /infra/autoscaler/status?pool=pool-A
{
  "desired": 200,
  "actual": 200,
  "max": 200,
  "scale_limit_hit": true,
  "last_alloc_error": "quota_exceeded"
}
```

Sam Park: We have two bottlenecks: 1) cloud quota / reserved capacity cap hit, autoscaler can't add GPUs; 2) runtime config (batching/prefix cache) that increased memory pressure and reduced throughput per GPU so queue filled existing GPUs faster.

Mei Li: Repro notes: rollback of batching window in staging restored prefix cache hit-rate to ~91% and throughput recovered. That points to deploy 2245 as root cause.

Priya Nair: Proposed immediate mitigations (short term):
- revert deploy 2245 to previous batching/caching config (rollback to 2244) — low risk and should reduce memory pressure
- temporarily increase pool-A max GPUs to 230 (if cloud quota allows) or request emergency quota increase
- enable model-fallback policy for heavy requests to smaller quantized variant (to reduce memory per request)
- protect premium routes with rate limit/burst throttle to reduce customer errors

Sam Park: Action assignments:
- Priya -> submit rollback + kick CI rollback job (run now)
- Carlos -> open emergency quota request with cloud console + try manual scale (if permitted) to 230
- Mei -> enable fallback model policy and monitor prefix_cache metrics
- Sam -> coordinate customer comms + update incident channel

oncall-bot: Priya Nair acknowledged the incident (oncall).

Priya Nair: Starting rollback now. Triggered `deploy rollback --service=runtime --to=2244`  (CI job queued).

Carlos Mendes: Contacted cloud support, case #CS-98432. They say quota increase may take 40-60m. Attempting manual scale via infra API anyway.

Carlos Mendes: Manual scale attempt: `POST /infra/pools/pool-A/scale {"target":230}` returned `403` with message `reserved_quota_limit`. Cloud refuses until quota uplift.

Mei Li: Fallback policy toggled for heavy routes. Observing small drop in memory pressure on first 3 nodes.

Sam Park: Customer impact assessment update: 15 high-traffic tenants affected with elevated latency. We should prepare banner for status.redwood.ai if rollback doesn't improve in 20m.

Priya Nair: Rollback completed and new runtime config rolled out to pool-A (2244). Observing immediate behavior.

Mei Li: Metrics flash: prefix_cache hit-rate climbing (18% -> 67%) and counting. Throughput per GPU recovering; queue length dropping from 18.4k -> 9.1k within 6m.

Sam Park: Good. We're seeing partial recovery. Keep measures in place until autoscaler/quota is resolved.

Carlos Mendes: Cloud support updated: they can grant temporary quota of +40 GPUs in 25-35m if we accept emergency flow. I've requested approval from infra leads.

Priya Nair: We should still plan a postmortem to examine why batching rollback wasn't caught by qa/perf tests. Also add gating on continuous_batch_window changes.

Mei Li: Suggestion: add canary experiment that measures prefix_cache_hit and throughput before rollout. Also automated perf regression alert if hit-rate drops >15%.

Sam Park: Customer comms: drafted short note —
"We experienced elevated latency and partial timeouts in west region due to an autoscaler quota limit combined with a batching config regression. We reverted the config and are working with cloud provider to increase quota. Services are improving; we will send a full postmortem." :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Handoff in 30m to Carlos. I'll stay till autoscaler quota resolved or we see steady state (queue <2k). If not, Carlos will lead overnight mitigation.

Carlos Mendes: Acknowledged handoff. My plan if quota not approved: 1) force route premium traffic to other regions, 2) enable more aggressive rate-limiting on low-priority routes, 3) increase fallback routing to quantized variants.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: Priya Nair -> Carlos Mendes at +30m. Pager duty page remains open.

Sam Park: Leaving this thread as primary incident record. Will update status page if customers ask. Great work all, keep updates short and actionable in this thread.

Priya Nair: Final quick update before handoff: queue at 1.9k, prefix_cache hit-rate 90%, impacted error-rate down to 0.6%. Rolling into monitoring phase.

Carlos Mendes: Taking over. I'll post any quota news here. If anything spikes, ping PagerDuty immediately.

incident-bot: Incident marked as ACTIVE -> MONITORING by Sam Park. Severity lowered to Sev-2 based on recovery progress.

Sam Park: Closing notes: follow-ups: runbook update for batching config, add autoscaler dashboard with `scale_limit_hit` metric, request quota pre-warming for critical pools.

Carlos Mendes: Copy. Creating follow-up tickets now.

Mei Li: thanks everyone.
